features.featureTitle: Extend the badge creation form in the Admin tab (BadgeManagement.tsx) to support all the following additional criteria types, each with an appropriate numeric threshold input: (1) totalDaysAvailable – number of days with availability set, (2) totalGamesPlayed – total games played milestones, (3) firstMatchLogged – first match logged (boolean/threshold of 1), (4) winPercentage – win percentage threshold (e.g. 60, 75), (5) bestWinStreak – best win streak milestones, (6) totalChatMessages – number of chat messages posted, (7) totalLikesReceived – number of likes received on chat messages, (8) firstImageUploaded – first image uploaded in chat (boolean/threshold of 1), (9) topLeaderboardPosition – reaching top N leaderboard position (e.g. 1, 3), (10) daysAtNumber1 – number of days holding the #1 leaderboard spot, (11) monthlyParticipation – matches played in a given month, (12) consecutiveWeeksAvailable – availability logged for X consecutive weeks. The existing criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames) must remain unchanged.

In the Leaderboard page (LeaderboardPage.tsx), reverse the sort order of dates in the dropdown used to add wins or losses, so that the most recent dates appear at the top and the oldest dates appear at the bottom.
